about.title: About Us
about.description: Meet ZignnnIt: a creative studio where design and code work as one. Our story, our process, our values and our team.

hero.title: We craft brands and products that stand out.
hero.subtitle: Brand identity, UI/UX and web & mobile development for ambitious businesses — from the first sketch to the final launch.
hero.illustrationTitle: Creative desk: screen with a design app, steaming cup, lamp, clock and cactus

about.title: Bringing Your Ideas to Life with <hl>Creativity and Innovation</hl>
about.imageAlt: The ZignnnIt workspace: a code editor and the ZignnnIt website on screen
about.p1: ZignnnIt is a key player in graphic design, UI/UX, and web & mobile development. We combine creativity and technical expertise to transform your ideas into impactful digital experiences.
about.p2: From conception to launch, we support our clients with a constant focus on quality and innovation. Together, let’s build products that inspire and shape the future of your business.

aboutPage.heroTitle: A creative studio where <hl>design and code</hl> work as one.
aboutPage.heroText: We help ambitious businesses stand out and run smoothly — from the brand identity to the product their customers use every day.
aboutPage.storyP1: ZignnnIt is built on a simple conviction: a brand and the digital products that carry it should be designed together. Based in Douala, Cameroon, we work with clients wherever they are, bringing graphic design, UI/UX and web & mobile development under one roof.
aboutPage.storyP2: Our mission: turn your ideas into digital experiences that are beautiful, useful and built to last. From the first sketch to the launch — and beyond — we stay by your side with a constant focus on quality, clarity and innovation.
aboutPage.processSubtitle: Four steps, one team, no gaps between design and development.

discover.title: Discover
discover.text: We listen, ask the right questions and study your market, your users and your goals.

design.title: Design
design.text: We shape the identity, the user journeys and the interfaces, and validate them with you.

build.title: Build
build.text: We develop fast, accessible and secure websites and apps, tested on real devices.

launch.title: Launch
launch.text: We put it online, measure what works and keep improving it with you.

craft.title: Craft
craft.text: Every pixel and every line of code matters. We sweat the details so you don’t have to.

clarity.title: Clarity
clarity.text: Plain language, honest timelines, no surprises. You always know where your project stands.

impact.title: Impact
impact.text: Beautiful is not enough: what we build has to serve your goals and your users.

partnership.title: Partnership
partnership.text: We work with you, not just for you — and we stay around after launch.

aboutPage.ctaText: Tell us about it — we reply within 24 hours.
